title: I-049 automatic sentence split into a timed DialoguePlan
clauseOfficialized: SentenceSplitter splits Latin and CJK punctuation into contiguous timed sentences; empty text and non-positive speed are refused; speed scales duration; a re-split keeps unchanged earlier sentence ids (content-hash ids) and assigns a new id to a rewritten sentence; the resulting DialoguePlan splices at 24 kHz with sample counts equal to the planned sum via FakeSpeechBackend. This is not a linguistic parser and not real TTS inference.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.14 officialized pre-split DialoguePlan and left automatic sentence split unofficialized.
rowsStillOpenOnI049: Real TTS inference (no speech model weights are downloaded or loaded)
